retrieved_synopses: Dammon sees Karlach and feels her infernal engine. Him having been a weaponsmith in hell knows how to upgrade it and offers his services if the party brings him some infernal metal.

Players find Dammon in HAV or LOW for the first or second time in the game with Karlach in your party. He will say that he knows a way to upgrade Karlach for the first or second time, depending on how her origin story evolved.
Follow up OM between Karlach and Dammon to give her her upgrades if she has infernal metal in her inventory.
Karlach mentions that the piece of infernal metal found could be given to Dammon.
context: Karlach has just received an upgrade to her infernal engine from Dammon, a former weaponsmith in Hell who offered to modify her if the party brought him a piece of infernal metal. The party encountered Dammon in Haven or the Lower City while Karlach was in the party, and the follow-up scene here plays out when the required infernal iron is available (this is Karlach’s first upgrade in this playthrough). Karlach reports the upgrade made her stronger but didn’t solve her overheating — she’s still too hot to be touched safely, though she playfully invites the player to try. She urges the party to find more infernal iron so Dammon can perform further modifications before she “overheats.”
